Role: Professor
Industry: Primary/Secondary Education
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The dashboard is very easy to be used. It's very simple to share your project with workers and eventually family.
Cons: When a new AI chat is opened, the size is to big in order to contine working and have the chat open. You always need to resize it.

Role: Project Manager
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I like the ease of use and constant support that the platform is offering. There are a lot of trainings which you could attend if you want to explore the more elaborate features. I think it offers good value for money and tracking tasks is intuitive and easy. The good things are also a variety of automatizations and integrations that it offers.
Cons: I don't like that after completing a task, most of the subtasks disappear or are hard to find. The old projects are also not easily retrieved, and sometimes you can lose tags and notifications in the interface.
Comments: I've been using it for over 2 years, and I feel like there are still features I could learn about and improve. For example creation of automatizations and the newly introduced AI summary system. In general, ClickUp is, in my opinion, cleaner than similar platforms and [truncated]

Role: Post production
Industry: Broadcast Media
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It’s really user friendly and so it’s easy to onboard people and get them up to speed. Also easy to set deadlines and priorities. We have a lot of work so it’s really important that we can order tasks by urgency.
Cons: You can’t ctrl-z (undo) when typing something into a new task, or copying and pasting in.
Comments: It’s been positive, we use it everyday and it makes life much easier. It’s really handy and doesn’t really ever fail us. Just gives a really clear overview to our assistants of what we’re working on.

Role: Operations Director
Industry: Accounting
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I love the customizability of the platform. Very versatile and can be used by seemingly any type of organization
Cons: Not super intuitive on the automations and the structure changed making it harder to understand how tasks and subtasks work. Subtasks can get buried if not careful
Comments: Fantastic! We are an accounting firm and being able to track tasks and history was great. The change in the platform made things a little tricky but good!
Reasons for choosing: Cheaper than most of the alternative products and fit the needs we had at the time
Reasons for switching: Trello was too manual for our processes and needs to automate
Switched from: Trello
Alternatives considered: Jira

Role: Recruitment specialist
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It is the best task management software on the market right now.
Cons: Nothing

Role: Office Administrative
Industry: Machinery
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I like its versatility: I can view my tasks and projects in different formats, from lists and dashboards to calendars and time maps. The option to customize task statuses and create automated workflows has given flexibility to our process. I especially appreciate the time tracking and goal setting features, which keep everyone accountable and focused.
Cons: While ClickUp has a lot to offer, its abundance of features can be overwhelming for new users.
Comments: ClickUp's versatility and customization features make it an excellent investment. I recommend ClickUp for an effective way to organize work and improve productivity.
Switched from: Miro|BigTime

Role: President
Industry: Health, Wellness and Fitness
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It's intuitive and easy to use. I can look at a project in many views (list, kanban, calendar, gantt) and more. I can create whiteboards, docs , mindmaps and block tasks and assign things to others.
Cons: There isn't much not to like, it suits my needs perfectly to create projects and see them through to completion with plenty of templates to get you started.
Reasons for choosing: i found these ease of use, UI, cost all easy to use and fair.
Alternatives considered: monday.com AI Work Platform

Role: Sales Manager
Industry: Automotive
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I use ClickUp so me and my team have a good workflow. Assigning each memeber for a task along with all the needed details is easy. There are a lot of options for each task and project and assigning best members for each task is a good option for a good workflow.
Cons: Learning to use ClickUp is not the easiest, but it can be learned to be used fast.

Role: Software Engineer
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 2
Pros: It was not very difficult to set it up, but it is far behind some competitors.
Cons: Its UI/UX is subject to improvement and it needs a lot of features to be on par with competitors.

Role: Copywriter
Industry: Writing and Editing
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: ClickUp is absolutely great in that there are many little things you can do with it from setting tasks to assigning multiple subtasks as well.
Cons: It is glitchy when setting up boards as it can take time for things to properly show up.
Comments: It is a pretty good system with a lot of options but it needs a bit of help as it is a bit glitchy.
Reasons for switching: It allowed more opportunity to make actions and mini actions.
Switched from: Trello
